rules.description: Annual holidays (AR 30 March 1967): maximum statutory 20 days in a 5-day regime (24 in a 6-day regime) = 4 weeks, earned from days worked/assimilated

source.title: ONVA/RJV: Calcul des jours de vacances (AR du 30 mars 1967)

versions.notes: ONVA/RJV: maximum 24 working days per year in a 6-day regime or 4 weeks in any regime (20 days in the 5-day regime); 231+ worked/assimilated days (5-day regime) give 20 days. The reference year (previous calendar year, "exercice de vacances") was not stated on the fetched page and is not modelled. Verified as the law in force on the verification date; historical effective date not researched, so effectiveFrom is set to 2026-01-01 (earlier dates resolve to the parent/none).

rules.description: National transposition status of the EU Pay Transparency Directive (EU) 2023/970

value.law: Community/regional measures only (incl. Flemish pay transparency decree of 2026-06-17, Brussels and French Community measures); no federal private-sector act notified

source.title: EUR-Lex: national transposition measures communicated for Directive (EU) 2023/970

versions.notes: EUR-Lex lists 6 Belgian measures, all regional/community (Wallonia, Flanders, French Community, Brussels-Capital). No federal law for private-sector employers notified as of 2026-10-18; press reports a 6-month extension request in June 2026 (not verified on an official site).
